mapper.select:
select count(*) from ${tableName}
and ${key}=#{valueStr}
SELECT DISTINCT object_name FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE = 'SCH'
select SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner,SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name as tableCode from SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES where SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner=#{owner} order by SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name asc

select SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner,SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name as tableCode, Sys_Table.table_id, Sys_Table.table_name as tableName, Sys_Table.Table_CreateTime from SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES left join Sys_Table on SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name= Sys_Table.Table_Code where SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner=#{owner} order by SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name asc

select lower(utc.table_name) as tableCode,utc.column_name as columnCode,column_id as columnId, data_type as dataType,data_Length as dataLength,data_Precision as dataPrecision,data_Scale as dataScale,constraint_type as isPek from SYS.user_tab_columns utc left join SYS.USER_CONS_COLUMNS cols on utc.table_Name=cols.table_Name and utc.column_Name=cols.column_Name left join SYS.USER_CONSTRAINTS cons on cols.constraint_name = cons.constraint_name where utc.table_name in (select table_name from SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES where owner=#{owner}) order by utc.table_name asc;

select utc.table_name as tableCode,utc.column_name as columnCode,column_id as columnId, data_type as dataType,data_Length as dataLength,data_Precision as dataPrecision,data_Scale as dataScale,constraint_type as isPek from SYS.user_tab_columns utc left join SYS.USER_CONS_COLUMNS cols on utc.table_Name=cols.table_Name and utc.column_Name=cols.column_Name left join SYS.USER_CONSTRAINTS cons on cols.constraint_name = cons.constraint_name where utc.table_name=#{tableCode} order by utc.table_name asc;

select lower(utc.table_name) as tableCode,utc.column_name as columnCode,column_id as columnId, data_type as dataType,data_Length as dataLength,data_Precision as dataPrecision,data_Scale as dataScale,constraint_type as isPek from SYS.user_tab_columns utc left join SYS.USER_CONS_COLUMNS cols on utc.table_Name=cols.table_Name and utc.column_Name=cols.column_Name left join SYS.USER_CONSTRAINTS cons on cols.constraint_name = cons.constraint_name where utc.table_name in (select table_name from SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES where owner=#{owner} and table_name=#{tableCode}) order by utc.table_name asc;
select SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner,SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name as tableCode from SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES where SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.owner=#{owner} and SYS.ALL_ALL_TABLES.table_name=#{tableCode}

select lower(table_name) as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,column_id as columnId, data_type as dataType,data_Length as dataLength,data_Precision as dataPrecision,data_Scale as dataScale from SYS.user_tab_columns where lower(table_name)=lower(#{tableCode}) and column_name=#{columnCode};

select FK_OWNER as fkOwner, FK_TABLE as fkTable, FK_COL as fkCol, PK_OWNER as pkOwner, PK_TABLE as pkTable, B.PK_COL as pkCol FROM ( SELECT t1.owner AS FK_OWNER, t1.table_name AS FK_TABLE, t1.constraint_name AS FK , t3.column_name AS FK_COL , T2.OWNER AS PK_OWNER, t2.table_name AS PK_TABLE, t1.r_constraint_name AS PK , T1.DELETE_RULE from dba_constraints t1, dba_constraints t2, DBA_CONS_COLUMNS t3 where t1.constraint_type= 'R' and t2.constraint_type= 'P' and t2.constraint_name= t1.r_constraint_name and t3.constraint_name= t1.constraint_name ) A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T1.constraint_name AS PK, T2.column_name AS PK_COL FROM dba_constraints T1, DBA_CONS_COLUMNS T2 WHERE T1.CONSTRAINT_TYPE= 'P' AND T1.constraint_name= T2.constraint_name )B ON A.PK=B.PK group by FK_OWNER, FK_TABLE, FK_COL, PK_OWNER, PK_TABLE, B.PK_COL having FK_OWNER=#{owner} and PK_OWNER=#{owner};
select tab.TABLE_SCHEMA as owner,tab.TABLE_NAME as tableCode from information_schema.tables as tab where tab.TABLE_SCHEMA=#{owner} order by tab.TABLE_NAME asc

select tab.TABLE_SCHEMA as owner,tab.TABLE_NAME as tableCode,Sys_Table.table_id, Sys_Table.table_name as tableName, Sys_Table.Table_CreateTime from information_schema.tables as tab left join Sys_Table on tab.table_name= Sys_Table.Table_Code where tab.TABLE_SCHEMA=#{owner} order by tab.TABLE_NAME asc

select table_name as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,data_type as dataType,IFNULL(character_maximum_length,numeric_precision) as dataLength,ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, column_type as columnType,numeric_precision as dataPrecision,numeric_scale as dataScale,COLUMN_KEY as isPek FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns where TABLE_SCHEMA = #{owner} order by table_name asc;

select table_name as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,data_type as dataType,IFNULL(character_maximum_length,numeric_precision) as dataLength,ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, column_type as columnType,numeric_precision as dataPrecision,numeric_scale as dataScale,COLUMN_KEY as isPek FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns where TABLE_SCHEMA = #{owner} and lower(table_name)=lower(#{tableCode}) order by table_name asc;

select table_name as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,data_type as dataType,IFNULL(character_maximum_length,numeric_precision) as dataLength,ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, column_type as columnType,numeric_precision as dataPrecision,numeric_scale as dataScale,COLUMN_KEY as isPek FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns where TABLE_SCHEMA = #{owner} and table_name=#{tableCode} order by table_name asc;

select table_name as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,data_type as dataType,IFNULL(character_maximum_length,numeric_precision) as dataLength,ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, column_type as columnType,numeric_precision as dataPrecision,numeric_scale as dataScale,COLUMN_KEY as isPek FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns where TABLE_SCHEMA =#{owner} and lower(table_name)=lower(#{tableCode}) order by table_name asc;

select table_name as tableCode,column_name as columnCode,data_type as dataType,IFNULL(character_maximum_length,numeric_precision) as dataLength,ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, column_type as columnType,numeric_precision as dataPrecision,numeric_scale as dataScale,COLUMN_KEY as isPek FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns where TABLE_SCHEMA =#{owner} and table_name=#{tableCode} order by table_name asc;
